links.outcome: ChatGPT differential diagnosis completeness and omission of important additional examinations in LHN cases
links.effect: Highest performance for primary (90%) and most plausible differential diagnoses (65%); additional examinations lowest; ChatGPT never indicated PET-CT, voice quality assessment, or impedance-pH monitoring.
links.quote: ChatGPT never indicated some important additional examinations (PET-CT, voice quality assessment, or impedance-pH monitoring).

screen.reason: Evaluates baseline diagnostic and management performance of ChatGPT across 40 clinical cases scored by experts, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
